summary: John's 12th-great-grandfather; died young at Tharston leaving five small children.
bio: Baptized 18 Jun 1581 at Saxlingham Thorpe & Nethergate, 'child of John Tuttill' (Norfolk RO PD 281/1). Moved about 3 miles to Tharston. Will dated 20 Mar 1618, proved 20 Apr 1619, naming 'John Gooch, father[-in-law]', 'Margaret Rau(e), mother-in-law', 'Ann Woodyard, kinswoman', 'John Tuthill, brother', wife Alice and five children. Buried at Tharston 26 Mar 1618.
